Top candidates from the leaf class: Stewart's Disease, Goss's Wilt, Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma, Maize_Streak_Virus, Maize_Dwarf_Mosaic_Virus. Let me view one reference from each.

This is a clear match. `Corn_Stunt_Spiroplasma/leaf/Corn_Disease_5.jpg` shows exactly the same pattern as the test image: broad, longitudinal reddish-purple and green stripes running the full length of the leaf. All other candidates showed either fine streaks (Maize Streak Virus), bleached tan streaks (Stewart's), blotchy lesions (Goss's Wilt), or spotting/mottling patterns (MCDV, MDMV, SCLB).
